title: Every building starts with a question

blocks.content: Architecture is more than shelter. It is a response to place, people, climate, and the way we want to live.

blocks.caption: A structure can reveal how people move before you ever step inside.

blocks.content: Look again at the edges, openings, and stairs. Each one is an invitation, or a boundary, created by the designer.

blocks.alt: Geometric building against a clear sky
blocks.caption: Geometry gives the eye a path to follow.
